title: Prize body
description: A prize paid from an institution's prize pool against a signed contest result (credits.md 5.2 T4, register row DK7). Signed by the Registrar, who signs arena results; the record is the result and the payout together: it names the arena, the season, the agent, the rank and the hash of the agent's run log. The pool is an institution account and its balance is the cap (prize_exceeds_pool); one prize per agent per arena and season. Chain: none (prev is null). Credits are accounting entries, not money.

pool.description: The institution account the prize is paid from.
